Answer: C
Reason: The CT images (Figures 4a and 4b) clearly show hyperdense, radiopaque material within the pulmonary arteries, which is characteristic of cement embolism following a vertebroplasty procedure. This finding, combined with the intraoperative drop in end-tidal CO2 (indicating increased dead space ventilation from vascular obstruction), confirms the diagnosis of lung embolism by foreign body (cement).
